overview_description.description:
Tenderly is a blockchain operations platform for teams running production systems onchain. It pioneered transaction simulation in web3 and built one of the first smart contract debuggers, and today gives engineering, finance, and risk teams a single environment to simulate, validate, and monitor onchain activity, so they can model the outcome of any transaction, integration, or capital allocation against live production state before it happens.

High-fidelity Simulations preview any onchain action against real, current state, including live oracle prices and synced liquidity. A multichain Explorer decodes transactions and contract activity into readable operational context. Real-time Monitoring detects anomalies and triggers automated, validated responses. The platform supports 100+ EVM networks, from Ethereum and leading Layer 2s (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon, Linea) to emerging chains such as World Chain, MegaETH, and Plasma.

Tenderly is a chosen infrastructure and tooling provider for major new networks, including Robinhood Chain, Circle's Arc, Sony's Soneium, and Tempo, the payments blockchain incubated by Stripe and Paradigm. Founded in 2018, it is used across the onchain ecosystem: by protocols such as Aave, Uniswap, Morpho, Safe, Chainlink, and Sky; by institutions, exchanges, and market makers including Kraken, Binance, Anchorage Digital, Maple, Tether, and Wintermute; and by security teams such as the Security Alliance (SEAL), zeroShadow, and Cyfrin. Teams have run more than 4 billion simulations and debugged over 10 million transactions on the platform, which powers protocols and organizations behind more than 50 billion dollars in onchain value.

about_short_description.short_description: Tenderly is a blockchain operations platform for simulating, validating, and monitoring onchain activity.

product.name: Tenderly Simulator
product.description: A blockchain simulation environment for testing transactions, multi-step flows, smart-contract changes, and cross-chain operations against current or historical network state before deployment.

product.name: Tenderly Console
product.description: An onchain investigation and operations interface for decoding transactions, tracing execution, analyzing contract failures, viewing cross-chain activity, and validating fixes through simulation.

product.name: Tenderly Monitor
product.description: An onchain monitoring and response service that detects transaction failures, state changes, balance movements, events, and other conditions, then delivers notifications or initiates validated actions.

product.name: Tenderly Node
product.description: A low-latency, production-oriented RPC infrastructure service that provides blockchain network access for applications, protocols, and ecosystem partners across supported chains.
